# Linear: DESIGN.md
> obsidian instrument panel, one lime signal

**Theme:** dark  
**Source:** https://linear.app/ · 2026-09-29

Source measurements are normalised; roles and recommendations are interpreted.

Linear is a black room with the lights kept deliberately low. The base is Obsidian, panels float above it in a barely lighter Ink, and edges are drawn with one white hairline at eight percent instead of any visible border. Nearly everything is Inter Variable, and the hierarchy rests on a single unusual weight: 510 for every headline, a value between regular and medium that reads as confident without ever becoming bold. Small titles step up to 590, body copy sits at 400, and Berkeley Mono appears only for eyebrows, code and machine voice, uppercase and quietly spaced. Text falls through five greys, from Silver down to Slate, so labels recede rather than shout. One lime, Voltage, lands as a real signal on an otherwise monochrome surface, and the white pill is the only inverted element on the page. Corners stay tight: 8px on chrome, 12px on floating panels, full pills on anything you press.

## At a glance

- **Typography:** Inter Variable does all the work at weight 510; Berkeley Mono speaks only in labels and code.
- **Imagery:** Product UI screenshots, dark and tightly cropped, glowing faintly against the page. No photography and no people, only interface windows and diagrams.
- **Logo:** A small white wordmark with a rounded glyph, drawn at 22px, understated and confident.
- **Motion:** Quick and switch-like: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) at 0.1s.
- **Color:** Matte blacks and five greys, broken once by a lime signal.
- **Iconography:** Filled 14px glyphs at 1.5px stroke, tight geometric corners, no library detected.
- **Voice:** Declarative and product-first, third person: "Purpose-built for planning and building products."
- **Framework:** Next.js, styled-components

## Colors

| Name | Value | Group | Role |
|------|-------|-------|------|
| Obsidian | `#08090a` | neutral | Page base and the deepest layer; also the text colour that sits on white pills. |
| Ink Panel | `#0f1011` | neutral | The dominant surface: product windows, comment cards and every embedded UI frame. |
| Graphite | `#161718` | neutral | Raised chips and message bubbles that sit one step above a panel. |
| Silver | `#f7f8f8` | neutral | Primary text and every headline; the system's maximum contrast. |
| Mist | `#d0d6e0` | neutral | Secondary headings, active nav items and dense UI labels inside mockups. |
| Fog | `#8a8f98` | neutral | Body copy, navigation and descriptions; the default reading grey. |
| Slate | `#62666d` | neutral | Tertiary text: placeholders, column headers, legal links, mono eyebrows. |
| Voltage | `#e4f222` | accent | The single lime signal, used on small status marks and product highlights only. |
| Paper | `#e5e5e6` | neutral | Inverted button surface for the one high-emphasis action in the header. |
| Hairline | `#ffffff14` | neutral | The universal border and divider: 8 percent white, sometimes 12 percent on floating panels. |

## Typography

### Inter Variable (display)
Everything that speaks: headlines, body, navigation, buttons, interface text. The signature move is weight 510 doing the work of bold at display size, with tighter tracking (-1.056px at 48px, -1.408px at 64px); nothing on the page is ever truly bold.
- **Fallback:** system-ui, sans-serif
- **Weights:** 300, 400, 500, 510, 590
- **Sizes:** 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, 24, 32, 48, 64
- **Line height:** 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** -0.182px

### Berkeley Mono (mono)
The machine voice: uppercase eyebrow labels at 12px/16.8px and every line of code inside an editor at 14px/24px. Never used for body prose, so monospace always reads as metadata.
- **Fallback:** ui-monospace, monospace
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12, 14
- **Line height:** 1.2
- **Letter spacing:** normal

### Type scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line height | Letter spacing |
|------|--------|--------|------|-------------|----------------|
| caption | Berkeley Mono | 400 | 12px | 1.4 | normal |
| body-sm | Inter Variable | 400 | 13px | 1.5 | -0.13px |
| body | Inter Variable | 400 | 14px | 1.5 | -0.182px |
| subtitle | Inter Variable | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | normal |
| title-sm | Inter Variable | 590 | 20px | 1.33 | -0.24px |
| title | Inter Variable | 510 | 32px | 1.1 | -0.5px |
| title-lg | Inter Variable | 510 | 48px | 1 | -1.056px |
| display | Inter Variable | 510 | 64px | 1 | -1.408px |

## Spacing and layout

**Density:** compact

- **Base unit:** 4px
- **Max page width:** 1436px
- **Section gap:** 48px
- **Card padding:** 12px 16px 16px
- **Element gap:** 6-8px

### Border radii

- **chip, small control:** 4px
- **button, nav item, textarea:** 8px
- **nested card, message bubble:** 9px
- **floating panel:** 12px
- **pill button, avatar, status dot:** 9999px

## Elevation

Depth is drawn, not thrown: a 1px inset ring (#ffffff14, #ffffff1f when floating, #232529 inset on solid chips) plus one soft ambient shadow, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0 2px 32px for panels and rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 0 0 0 1px for nested cards. No large blur, no coloured glow.

## Components

### primary button
**Role:** The single inverted action, header only.

Paper #e5e5e6 background, Obsidian text, Inter Variable 13px weight 510, line-height 32px, radius 9999px, padding 0 12px, 1px solid Paper border, layered near-invisible drop shadow. Inverts the whole page in one 32px pill.

### secondary button
**Role:** Dark pill for the quieter equivalent action.

rgba(255,255,255,0.05) fill, Silver text, Inter Variable 16px weight 510, line-height 44px, padding 0 20px, radius 9999px, 1px inset ring rgba(255,255,255,0.03) plus a 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) outer ring and a 4px drop shadow. Hover lightens the fill, never the text.

### nav link
**Role:** Header and footer navigation.

Fog #8a8f98 text, transparent background, Inter Variable 13px weight 400, line-height 19.5px, radius 9999px, padding 0 12px. Hover lifts the colour to Silver over color 0.1s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94); active items use one of the two 12px pills in the header.

### panel card
**Role:** Any floating surface: product window, agent panel, changelog entry.

Ink Panel #0f1011 background, 12px radius, 1px solid Hairline #ffffff1f, shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0 2px 32px, no padding on the shell itself. Nested content cards drop to Graphite #161718, 9px radius and a 1px #ffffff14 ring with 12px 16px 16px padding.

### composer input
**Role:** Chat and code entry inside a panel.

rgba(255,255,255,0.02) fill, 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05), radius 8px, padding 16px, Silver text in Inter Variable 16px/1.5. The code variant swaps to Berkeley Mono 14px with line-height 24px and no background of its own. Placeholder is Slate #62666d.

## Motion

Fast and switch-like, never decorative: colour and background change in 0.1s on cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), filter at 0.16s for hover on visuals, and only the long reveals use transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) for scroll-in panels.

## Layout

A centred 1436px shell with a fixed 32px gutters rule (0px 32px appears 65 times, the system's most repeated value). Content is left-aligned and asymmetric: an oversized display headline sits left with a small right-aligned link on the same baseline, then a full-width product window breaks the grid. Vertical rhythm is built from 4, 6 and 8px gaps inside components and 48px between sections.

## Imagery

Product UI screenshots, dark and tightly cropped, glowing faintly against the page. No photography, no people, only interface windows, agent panels and diagrams rendered in the app's own palette.

## Do and don't

### Do
- Set every headline in Inter Variable at weight 510 with negative tracking; never use 700.
- Build surfaces as Obsidian base, Ink Panel for anything floating, Graphite only for nested chips inside a panel.
- Draw edges with a 1px #ffffff14 hairline instead of a heavier border or a shadow alone.
- Keep pills at 9999px for all buttons and nav items, and cap everything else at 8px or 12px.
- Spend Voltage #e4f222 on one small status mark at a time; it loses all meaning past that.
- Use Berkeley Mono only uppercase at 12px for eyebrows and at 14px inside code, never for prose.

### Don't
- Never introduce a second accent hue: no blue links, no gradients, no coloured buttons.
- Do not add photographs, stock people or illustration; imagery is always the interface itself.
- Never set body copy lighter than Fog #8a8f98 on a dark surface, the greys do the whole hierarchy.
- Do not use large radii on panels or square corners on buttons; the 8/12/pill split is fixed.
- Avoid heavy borders, drop shadows over 32px blur, or any glow behind an element.
- Do not repeat the lime, the white pill or the display size more than once per view.

## Agent prompt

Design a dark product site in the Linear system: Obsidian #08090a base, Ink Panel #0f1011 floating surfaces, Graphite #161718 nested chips, text falling through Silver #f7f8f8, Mist #d0d6e0, Fog #8a8f98 and Slate #62666d, one Voltage #e4f222 signal, and Paper #e5e5e6 for a single inverted pill. Type is Inter Variable with headlines at weight 510 and negative tracking, Berkeley Mono for uppercase eyebrow labels and code only. Borders are 1px #ffffff14, radii are 8px, 12px or full pills, spacing runs on 4px with 32px page gutters, and transitions use cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) at 0.1s.
